prompt:

No photorealism, deep perspective, cinematic realism, elaborate textures or gradients on faces. Human has a perfectly round oversized PURE WHITE head, tiny black oval eyes and small line mouth, no hair, ears, nose, eyebrows or face shading. One navy-blue short-brim fisherman cap and a small flat yellow life jacket with two padded flaps and one simple buckle over the thin stick torso. No scarf, bandage or backpack. Compact stick figure matching the approved line-body reference proportions. Adults, not babies. One named individual appears once. Sea creatures have bold simple silhouettes and their own dark teal or desaturated purple colours, huge compared with the small boat, scary through scale and partial visibility rather than gore. Changes of action, camera or environment never authorize changing the character design or illustration technique. Night and underwater descriptions change the environment palette only; the character stays flat pure white with the same navy/yellow clothes. No oval/profile/beaked face, extra anatomy, thicker limbs, glossy shading, bloom, rim light, painterly texture, 3D lighting, chibi redesign or realistic rendering. Use two tiny black eyes and a short simple mouth, no drawn human features. Keep a readable front or three-quarter round head when the face is visible. Sea creatures use the same outlined flat illustration language, simple threatening shapes, not goofy smiling faces.
